$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F06 front (A1). Its lens is one shield seen through the front's two openings, a gradient from smoke to clear; each opening is its own lens entry, not convex (the nose arch bites into it). The temples seen through the lens go with the gradient refit; at the top of the image-left opening SAM left the dark temple out of the lens, where it opens onto the rim, so it is added by hand (lenses.add), as is the band along the top of that opening that SAM stopped short of (and a short stretch of the other opening's top, where it stopped 10 px short): up to the lens's edge measured in the picture (the half-way point between rim and lens in each column), carried on along its slope where the temple behind makes the lens as black as the rim.

lenses.name: shield lens, wearer's right half (image left)
shield lens, wearer's left half (image right)
